title: Cryptid
author: MathIsFun0
description: Pinned to the released tag. The community index names a bare commit SHA (0974a5d) for Cryptid, and every fallback path from there lands on the default branch, which is 0.5.17~dev -- an unreleased build that requires Steamodded >=1.0.0~BETA-1925a. The released v0.5.16d requires only >=1.0.0~BETA-1501a. Nobody ships 0.5.17~dev; the Cryptid Discord and the GitHub releases page both point at v0.5.16d, so that is what the vault should hold. Remove this file once the index catches up to a real release.
